text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.N. arms envoy Richard Butler expresses satisfication over results of his talks in Iraq.
- French students in Iraq to acquaint themselves with deteriorating health situation.
- Iraq and Tunisia sign trade and agriculture cooperation agreement.
(The above were also carried by THAWRA and QADISSIYA)
- Oil undersecretary says Iraq able to export 2.5 million barrels of oil per day from today.
- Trade minister says Iraq to attend a trade fair in Damascus next month.
